native_text.adaptation: Separate native font/material/atlas instances for skills; preserve the original initial atlas during Windows builds (m_ClearDynamicDataOnBuild 1 -> 0). character_shader.adaptation: Select the original Universal2D pass with the built-in desktop preview camera. Preserve all original GPU variants, alpha unpremultiplication, HSV arithmetic, saturation clamp, alpha discard, blending and depth/stencil state.

localized_font.operation: MultiLanguageText.RefreshFont selects the original CN region FZY4K font before Refresh text; preserve prefab font provenance and verify each differing font has an enabled MultiLanguageText.

cultivation_scroll.operation: C# namespace and decompiler operator/base-call syntax repair; retain original scrolling and virtualization.
